text:
Maya R: Quick favor — I pushed a tiny refactor that renames kv_cache -> kv_store in the fused ops and added a sampling hook. Can folks run a microbench on paged+flash on lab A100s? Looking for 1) tail latency on long seqs, 2) NVTX traces for op boundaries. PR #1421. Example run: ```bash
python bench.py --model=redwood/llama-13b --mode=paged+flash --seq=4096 --batch=1 --iters=30 --profile=nsys --kv-mode=shard
``` I pushed a canary image: gcr.redwood/kvpatch:canary. If you have time run on a single A100-40G node. Please try both `--kv-prefetch` and without. Thanks :pray:

Avik D: on it, will run tonight on lab-a100-07. Do you want op-level NVTX only or full nsys capture? Also any specific seed/input to reproduce the spikes? :eyes:

Maya R: NVTX preferred but nsys is fine if you have it. Seed: 42. Use the prompt in `tests/longseq_prompt.txt`. Also try toggling prefetch: `--kv-prefetch` vs none.

Tony L: heads up — I pushed an amend to CR #1421 for a tensor-name nit; shouldn't affect perf. I'll kick off a quick run now.

CI Bot: build started for gcr.redwood/kvpatch:canary on lab-a100-07 (job 7823). Logs: https://ci.redwood/job/7823

Lucas P: first pass results: baseline tail median ~220ms -> 320ms for seq=4096; with kvpatch median ~260ms but rare spikes to 500ms. Uploaded NVTX/nsys: s3://redwood/traces/kvpatch/2456789012.nsys. Re-running with `--kv-prefetch=false`.

Maya R: could you also enable memory dump at the end? bench harness accepts `--dump-mem`. If possible, also `--collect-kv-stats` so we can see prefetch hit rates.

Lucas P: added `--dump-mem` and `--collect-kv-stats`, rerunning now.

Tony L: quick grep of the trace shows kernel fallback aligned with spikes: ```text
[nvtx] attn_k_split fallback at 00:02:34
``` Looks like a kernel name mismatch is triggering slower path.

Avik D: if it's a kernel fallback, we can probably steer it with block size config. There's a runtime config `serving/runtime/kernel/block_sizes.json` in the canary image. Try setting `attn_block` to 128 for a quick test.

Maya R: could someone run a short check with `--attn-block=128 --iters=5` and paste median?

Avik D: ran that now on lab-a100-07: median dropped to ~210ms and I don't see the >500ms spikes. Pushing a tiny patch to add a `--force-attn-128` flag for canary runs.

Maya R: awesome. If consensus, I'll open a follow-up PR to make attn_block runtime-tunable with a fallback threshold. For now paste final numbers (median, p95, max) + NVTX trace link and CI artifact. I'll correlate.

CI Bot: build 7823 completed: success. Image pushed gcr.redwood/kvpatch:canary-7823

Lucas P: final (prefetch=on, attn_block=128): median 205ms, p95 310ms, max 330ms. Trace: s3://redwood/traces/kvpatch/2456789012-attn128.nsys

Tony L: my run: median 208ms, p95 315ms, max 340ms.

Maya R: perfect — I'll draft a short internal note and tag runtime-owners with numbers + artifacts. Thanks all :rocket:
